dedupe_keys.name: metropole de lyon cycling and walking datasets

description: Métropole de Lyon: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aménagements cyclables de la Métropole de Lyon; Plan Vélo de la Métropole de Lyon; Pompes à vélo en libre-service à la Métropole de Lyon; Stations Vélo'v de la Métropole de Lyon. Formats seen: CSV, GEOJSON, SHP, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
